text: Blox has been great! Small businesses are often targeted by bad actors, and individually, we have limited resources to protect ourselves. Blox changes that by allowing businesses to work together, share information, and protect one another. The best part is that the network only gets stronger with every new store that joins. It's a fantastic concept that gives small businesses a collective voice and a stronger line of defense against fraud.
